<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Recovery:</strong> Indian indices rebounded with the Sensex and Nifty posting gains as renewed FII buying and broad-based sectoral support offset concerns over crude oil price volatility and US-Iran tensions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxPSlNfR2tKazFfaFotN2RQMmJwekhTUEREa09OQWkyQ1cyOHRScE1XcHhUNXVxT2t2a3A5SXZILTlIcFlTQlVESmlkYm1JTmNkQmVwcTc0Y0VvQ1VRUEd6SmJ4QS0wRTZSTWRyYjNmaXJfRjUwQXdzc3l3YVlBQl9GaXlvYV94WHRvV1dMeWhKbmxlWWdXYkNkX1FFWXNyVzNyVmxDQUVSeHJNRWg1NDBVRGNvTjVaQVdyVkxxbjhNNFd3OGZIelloQQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a></span></li>

</ul>
